# Lian Labs Ethiopia

> Lian Labs is a software company in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (Rayuma Building, 9th floor). It builds business software, websites, mobile apps and payment integrations for Ethiopian companies, schools and organisations, and runs its own products. Clients worldwide are served at https://lian-labs.com.

Contact: contact@lian-labs.com

## Services

- Custom business software, websites and web platforms, mobile apps, Telebirr/Chapa/bank payment and SMS integration, school management, AI and automation: /services

## Products

- Lian SMS, school management system: /products/lian-sms
- Lian Property, property management system: /products/lian-property
- Gojo, dating app for the Habesha community: /products/gojo
